issues.desc: background.md lacks an explicit Done-When / user-observable outcome section. The operator cannot tell from the background alone what they should see when this story is complete. CHK-002 partially covers this (run smoke, see each block reason), but the background should state something like: Done When the operator can run the smoke task and see each of the four block reasons fire on its provable case and degrade to advisory on the non-provable case, with a clean disjoint decomposition returning no block. This is advisory because CHK-002 does describe the verification, and this is a mid-program building block (Story 2/6) whose user-facing wiring is in Story 5.

background.md Solution Tradeoffs claims terminalPhases from parallel-policy.ts is reusable as a single source, but parallel-policy.ts does NOT export terminalPhases — it is a local const inside resolveParallelSafety (line 53) and summarizeParallelPolicy (line 94). Implementer cannot import it; they must re-define the set or refactor parallel-policy.ts to export it. The single-source claim is factually inaccurate.
